Having contributed directly over several decades towards creating and enhancing Malta’s hard-won reputation as a reliable and effective international centre for financial and maritime services, we seek to provide high standards of legal advisory services in a wide spectrum of international commercial and corporate activities.

entityName: CNR - ISTITUTO DI SCIENZA, TECNOLOGIA E SOSTENIBILITA' PER LO SVILUPPO DEI MATERIALI CERAMICI (ISSMC)
entityDescription: The Institute of Science, Technology and Sustainability for Ceramics (ISSMC) is the Italian Hub of Excellence on Ceramic Materials, where the idea, design and development of new ceramic and hybrid materials takes place for the benefit of industry and the whole society, and where advanced training is carried out in the field of materials science addressed to fields of major current interest: Aero-space, Wellness and Health, Energy, Nano-remediation & safety, Environment, Construction and Cultural Heritage. In our vision, we pursue the enhancement of trans-disciplinarity, the integration of non-conventional technologies and the development of new processes for multi-materials. ISSMC has multi-disciplinary expertise and carries out the entire chain of development spanning from basic research to design, from the synthesis of base materials to forming processes, consolidation techniques and also functionalisations up to the development of prototypes and / or pilot plants. ISSMC has several collaborations in Europe and overseas (USA, Japan, etc) and is involved in numerous national and international research and training programs, many of which with the role of Project Coordinator. The interaction and collaboration with the industrial field are developed and supported by numerous technology transfer projects through the creation of spin-offs and / or licensing of patents related to new processes and products developed in ISSMC.

Immersive Data Analytics is a VR first collaborative visualisation and exploration platform. 
Our organisation develops advanced immersive analytics platforms to support the exploration, interpretation, and collaborative analysis of complex space-related datasets. We specialise in integrating heterogeneous data sources, including Earth observation, astronomical, and simulation data, within scalable cloud-based infrastructures. Our systems enable users to interact with high-dimensional data through intuitive, spatial visualisation environments, enhancing situational awareness and accelerating scientific and engineering insight. We focus on supporting multi-user, distributed workflows that align with modern space mission operations, data exploitation, and downstream service development. By combining immersive technologies with AI-driven data processing, we aim to contribute to next-generation capabilities in space science, mission analysis, and Earth observation applications in line with European space ecosystem priorities.

AGREO-Europe KFT. was found as a start-up SME by Bernadett Csonka (100% share) in Hungary on 26th of January 2021, with the mission to develop Earth Observation based services for the agri-environment, biodiversity and climate mitigation domains. Another reason of founding Agreo-Europe KFT. was to continue acting in European market as a policy influencer as from the private sector. AGREO contributes to the mission of DG Agri and DG JRC to support the early adopter member states with EO-image processing technological solutions, linking the knowledge of sustainable, ecological agriculture to the new Common Agricultural Policy approach called Area Monitory System. 
Our expert team participates in projects analysing land cover, land use changes in relation to agri-environmental systems and climate change in their temporal aspects, also targeting EO-based indicator concepts and integrated planning to support strategic decisions in our ever-changing environment. We are enforcing open data sharing and data interoperability concepts.

entityDescription:
Asociación gvSIG is a Spanish non-profit organisation established in 2009 to promote, coordinate and disseminate the gvSIG open-source geospatial ecosystem. The association supports the development and adoption of free and open-source technologies for Geographic Information Systems, Spatial Data Infrastructures and geospatial data management.
Its activities focus on dissemination, community building, training, cooperation, innovation projects and the promotion of open standards and interoperability in the geospatial sector. Asociación gvSIG has contributed to the international positioning of gvSIG as a recognised open-source GIS initiative, supporting collaboration among public administrations, universities, companies and international organisations.
The association has experience in national and international cooperation and innovation projects, particularly in the fields of geomatics, open-source software, Spatial Data Infrastructures, public-sector digital transformation and capacity building. It works in close coordination with the gvSIG ecosystem and with specialised technology providers to promote sustainable, interoperable and reusable geospatial solutions.

entityDescription:
SCOLAB Software Colaborativo S.L. is a Spanish IT company specialised in the development and implementation of geospatial information systems and spatial data infrastructures. The company provides services in software development, system integration, consultancy, technical support and maintenance, with a strong focus on open-source technologies, interoperability and international geospatial standards.
SCOLAB is the main technical and commercial entity behind the gvSIG Suite, including gvSIG Online, a web-based platform for Spatial Data Infrastructures and geoportals, and gvSIG Mapps, a mobile solution for geospatial field data capture and management. Its solutions are mainly addressed to public administrations and organisations requiring efficient, customisable and interoperable tools for the management, publication and analysis of spatial data.
The company has extensive experience in national and international projects, including deployments for regional and local governments in Spain, projects in Latin America, and collaborations with international organisations. SCOLAB combines technical expertise in GIS, web platforms, mobile applications, spatial databases and open standards with a practical understanding of public-sector digital transformation needs.

Korotu Technology is an award winning Canadian corporation, recognized by Clean50, WWF-Canada, and Foresight Canada for our leadership and innovation in Canada’s clean technology sector. Our award-winning Aroa Platform leverages advanced remote sensing and GIS technologies to deliver powerful insights into natural assets, helping clients prioritize, measure, monitor, and report on critical environmental efforts. Our services include canopy cover assessments, carbon assessments, and monitoring forest disturbances and health, which are essential for organizations seeking to optimize natural resource management, improve climate resilience, and inform adaptation strategies. With a proven track record in Ontario, British Columbia, and the Maritimes, Korotu is well-positioned to meet the growing demand for data-driven solutions to environmental challenges and conservation.

We are working towards a world where 30% of the Earth's surface is meaningfully protected from deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change impacts in the next decade. Our vision is to robustly protect critical ecosystems through collaboration among land stewards, farmers, Indigenous peoples, funders, and policy setters.

entityDescription:
Christof Systems GmbH (CS) is generally engaged in process-engineering plants, special-purpose machinery, and customer-specific installations in fluid technology for the:
- automotive industry,
- food industry,
- healthcare industry,
- oil and gas industries, including renewable media and energy carriers such as hydrogen.

The maturity level of the plants ranges from R&D and pilot plants to commercial plants and small series production. The focus is on modular systems that are built as skid-mounted units, enabling very rapid implementation at the customer’s site.

CS delivered dozens of highly specialized integrated environmental testing solutions to customers around the world.
To enhance the state of the art, CS conducts R&D projects and cooperates with universities and research facilities in Europe.
CS has many years of experience in the engineering and implementation of process-engineering plants. Project execution covers engineering across all phases (basic and detailed engineering, both electrical and mechanical, software programming, automation) through to realization, commissioning, and customer service.
In particular, for its proprietary products in the medical waste equipment segment (SinTion, etc.) and in the food industry, CSG operates a comprehensive service and maintenance organization to provide optimal customer support and ensure the availability of critical system components. Service and maintenance activities are primarily carried out within Europe; however, the company operates globally in principle.

WIRED 3D GmbH is a German high-tech startup specializing in advanced metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing).
Founded as a spin-off from the Ravensburg-Weingarten University of Applied Sciences,
the company focuses on developing and operating proprietary 3D printing systems designed to produce complex metal components with high precision and efficiency.
Core Activities & Technology The company has developed an integrated 3D printing ecosystem, which includes:
- Proprietary Hardware & Software: Development of custom 3D printers and process-specific algorithms to optimize production speed and component quality.

- Large-Scale Metal Printing: Capability to produce metal parts in various sizes, ranging from small, intricate components to large-scale objects (up to 500 x 500 x 1500 mm).

- Material Diversity: Expertise in working with different metals, including steel and stainless steel, ensuring high material integrity (minimal impurities) and reproducible mechanical properties.

- Engineering Services: Providing bionic and intelligent component design to maximize strength while minimizing wall thickness and weight.

Mission & Target Markets WIRED3D aims to offer a faster, more cost-effective, and sustainable alternative to traditional metal manufacturing. entityDescription:
Entity Description: Wavelet BeamWavelet Beam is a high-tech engineering entity specializing in advanced digital signal processing and video enhancement for mission-critical applications. The core of our innovation is the IRIS Video Noise Management system, a proprietary, CUDA-accelerated HPC framework designed to surgically lift valid video signals out of the noise floor, recovering critical image information that was previously hidden by video noise. Unlike conventional denoising solutions that often blur image content and sacrifice spatial resolution in challenging low-light sequences, IRIS preserves fine structures, textures, and edge integrity.Our technology ecosystem is built around four primary pillars: 
• IRIS & IRIS.RAW: Providing high-precision noise reduction at the earliest stage of the imaging chain to maintain raw data integrity. • IRIS.ANALYST: An enhancement engine optimized to maximize information density for human and automated analysis in low-SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) environments.• IRIS.BROADCAST: Delivering unmatched real-time HPC performance up to 8K@60fps for demanding live-stream and ground-segment applications. • IRIS Adaptive Encoding: An intelligent pre-processing layer that optimizes data streams for transmission and storage. By removing irrelevant noise while maintaining data integrity, we enable bit-rate reductions of 30% or even higher.

To ensure the physical correctness required for space-grade data and scientific analysis, we utilize a dedicated 16-bit processing pipeline that eliminates rounding errors and banding. Wavelet Beam leverages advanced CUDA core development to position these specialized capabilities for the space and ground segments, with a focus on satellite imagery optimization, space debris detection, and high-performance archival and video distribution workflows within HPC environments.

entityDescription:
MapScan is a Denmark-based geospatial services provider specializing in GIS, Earth Observation, LiDAR, and UAV-based data collection. The company delivers high-precision, standardized spatial data and analytical products for B2B clients across environmental monitoring, infrastructure, and engineering domains.
With over 19 years of professional experience, MapScan focuses on systematic, SLA-driven data acquisition and processing, ensuring consistent, repeatable, and high-quality geospatial outputs. The company provides end-to-end solutions, from field data collection (UAV, LiDAR, bathymetric and terrestrial surveys) to advanced data processing, GIS integration, and development of custom geospatial platforms.
Core competencies include environmental and biodiversity monitoring using time-series spatial data, volumetric analysis and stockpile monitoring, orthomosaic and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) generation, vectorization, and Scan-to-BIM workflows. MapScan also delivers hydrographic and bathymetric surveys, supporting water resource management and coastal monitoring.
The company has strong expertise in building interoperable geospatial systems aligned with international standards, supporting integration into CAD, BIM, and GIS environments. MapScan develops tailored GIS solutions using modern spatial technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, and web mapping frameworks.
Its services are applied across multiple sectors, including environmental protection, municipalities and asset management, construction and BIM, natural resources, infrastructure, and water management.
MapScan’s mission is to provide reliable, ready-to-integrate geospatial data and digital infrastructure that support evidence-based decision-making, operational efficiency, and sustainable resource management.

entityDescription:
Meteogrid S. L. is a privately owned company based in Madrid, Spain, offering high value-added products and services in the field of weather and applied meteorology, weather forecasting and risk management. Its technical team has been working in these fields since 1992.
The range of services offered by Meteogrid covers various application fields, such as natural disasters, extreme weather, civil protection emergencies, hydrology, energy, transport, agriculture and civil engineering among others, for which accurate weather forecasting is required and is used in high value-added products such as Early Warning Systems (EWS). Our clients are both administrations and public entities, for example in the field of natural risks, civil protection, hydrology, etc., and private companies, as in the case of energy, agriculture and transport.

Since 1996 Meteogrid's technical team has developed and improved Weather Forecasting Systems (WFS), bringing together highly qualified experts in the areas of meteorology, natural hazards and computing. After a detailed analysis of society's needs in the field of meteorological services, the first version of the WFS was designed to meet these needs, focusing on technical users. The developed WFS produces high added value probabilistic forecasts for the next ten days, using in a robust way the Ensemble Prediction System (EPS) of the European Centre for Medium Term Prediction (ECMWF). The reliability of the WFS is very high, as verified by independent third parties who have tested it and compared it with other available predictions (including those of the Spanish State Meteorological Agency, AEMet).
Meteogrid's technical team has developed a sophisticated EWS integrated into a Geographical Information System (GIS) environment, in a process of continuous improvement since 2000. This GIS integrates weather observations and forecasts from as many data sources as available (including Meteogrid's own WFS). The EWS includes multiple functionalities and tools, such as the user-configurable alert module (according to the area of interest, thresholds of significant variables, alert communication mode, etc.), or various simulation modules coupled with the weather forecast.
As a result, in Spain, most of the technical management for activities depending on or affected by meteorology uses the products and services that the system offers. Application areas include water management, emergencies (civil protection operations, wildfires, floods, etc.), energy (production -hydroelectric, wind, solar...-, distribution, consumption forecasting), transport and traffic (road network, railway network, etc.), precision agriculture, environmental protection, etc.

Although Meteogrid has focused its operations in Spain and the Mediterranean countries of Europe, the company has also developed its activity in other parts of the world, more particularly Latin America and Asia.

entityDescription:
STRAIN S.r.l. is an innovative aerospace technology company and accredited spin-off of the University of Rome Tor Vergata (Italy), officially authorized in 2025. The company originates from more than a decade of academic research in advanced composite materials, smart structures, and sustainable manufacturing technologies developed within the university’s Manufacturing Technology Research Group.
STRAIN was established to industrialize research results in smart polymer composites and transform them into space-qualified mechanical subsystems and high-value aerospace solutions. The company operates at the intersection of advanced materials engineering, mechanical subsystem design, and sustainable space technologies.
The founding team combines academic excellence and industrial aerospace experience. STRAIN’s technical leadership includes senior professors in Manufacturing Technology and Sustainable Production Systems with extensive experience in ESA and ASI research programs on composite materials, structural design, and smart systems. The CEO brings over 18 years of industrial experience in aerospace composite structures and European collaborative R&D projects.
This multidisciplinary background enables STRAIN to bridge academic research and industrial qualification, ensuring both scientific rigor and engineering reliability.
The company’s core competencies include:
Design and development of composite-based mechanical subsystems

Smart material engineering and thermo-mechanical modeling

Finite element analysis and structural optimization

Prototype manufacturing and composite processing

Integration and testing in accordance with ECSS standards

Technology transfer and intellectual property management

STRAIN operates through a structured collaboration framework with the University of Rome Tor Vergata and industrial partners, ensuring access to laboratory facilities, composite processing infrastructure, and environmental testing capabilities. This hybrid academic–industrial model allows the company to maintain high innovation capacity while aligning with industrial qualification requirements.
The company is positioned within the European upstream space sector as a technology-oriented SME focused on lightweight, sustainable, and ITAR-free mechanical solutions. STRAIN aligns its development roadmap with ESA strategic priorities, including Clean Space, Zero Debris, and European technological autonomy.
